text_block_list.text:
"One day, having reached a milestone,
we went on the 'reward trip' we had promised earlier."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: This is a splendid inn, isn't it...
choice_data_list: Apparently it's a traditional inn that's been around for 100 years.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You looked it up for me...? You really are amazing, Trainer...

Not only the inn, but I've also done thorough research
on the sightseeing spots in the surrounding area.

Cheval Grand invited me on a getaway trip
for my sake. While I'm grateful for
her thoughtfulness, I can't help but feel...
"Cheval Grand is the one who worked hard up until today. In that case, I want to reward her for her efforts."
Tour the famous sights, savor the local cuisine, and soothe your fatigue in the hot springs. The hospitality plan is flawless!
choice_data_list: Let's drop our bags in the room and go sightseeing!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

Leaving the luggage in the room, I hurriedly head to the entrance.
However—
(Shaaaa...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A downpour...

To think my plans would fall apart right from the start.
My shoulders drop just thinking about how hyped up I was...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um, Trainer...?
M-May I... come in...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I brought playing cards.
So, ...er...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-W-Would you like to do it together...!?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. Want to play Old Maid or something?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! All right, I'll play my card...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... which one is the Old Maid, I wonder?

Cheval Grand has only two cards left in her hand.
The outcome of the match hinges on which one is drawn, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Well... I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-Well, who knows...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
For laughing like that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Trainer-san was struggling so much,
and giving it everything....”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...

It looks like Cheval Grand is having
a truly wonderful time.
...Which makes it all the more unfortunate.

If only things had gone according to plan,
I could have entertained her even more.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Rain...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm having fun... really.
Spending time in the room like this...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the rain is so soothing,
and I can really take things easy...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Besides, Trainer is—

text_block_list.name: Inn Server
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
The bath is ready for you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!?
U-U-Understood! I'm c-c-coming!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-What on earth did I just—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, please don't worry about it!
I'm having a lot of fun, really...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Well then, um...
I'll be going to take a bath now...
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U-Um! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I just heard from the innkeeper.
Apparently there's a great fishing spot near here.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The rain's stopped for now,
and the water's murky, so they might be biting like crazy...
choice_data_list: (Fishing, huh. Now that I think about it...)

text_block_list.text:
There should be a fishing tackle rental shop nearby.
Our sightseeing plan went down the drain, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y... Yes!

Side by side, we cast our fishing lines.
As we waited for the fish, we strained our ears and...
(Whooosh... Whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: Spending time like this is really nice...
Spending time like this is nice, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I was thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it.
I was gazing at it that day too... the sea...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The day I first met you, Trainer...
You called out to me, but I ran away...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: When we met again later, I was truly surprised...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You teach me about the parts of myself I never knew.
And inside your eyes... I see myself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: She reached out her hand... straight toward me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And... they brought me to sights
I could never have seen on my own.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Thanks to you, Trainer, my world has expanded."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: It's precisely because you're like that that I feel so at ease.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Just being together with you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So……
Just being able to come here together makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because the time I spend with you, Trainer,
is the greatest reward of all... to me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......
I hope that's true for you too, Trainer...

Listening to Cheval Grand's faltering words,
I suddenly realize something.

Whether at a rainy inn or along this shoreline,
these casual moments spent by her side
are deeply precious to me as well—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wait......

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Aaaaargh!
Wh-What on earth am I saying……?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's a bother having something like this sprung on you, right...!
Aha, maybe the hot spring is making me dizzy...?
choice_data_list: I feel the same way, Cheval.
I feel the same way, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh!!??
U-Um... th-that means...!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: Shall we take it easy for a little longer?

text_block_list.text:
After that, we didn't catch a single fish.
Even so—

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Cheval Grand...
